sentences.text: In the passover round, nobody is appearing for the Petitioner.
I have perused the writ petition with the help of Shri Jitendra Shrivastava, learned Panel Lawyer for the State.

By this Petition, the Petitiner has prayed following reliefs:-
The FIR Annexure P/1 was recorded on 3.8.2021 at the instance of the Prosecutrix for the offence under Sections 376(2)(n) and 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 pertaining to Crime No.0011 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Harda.
There is no material on record to substantiate any of the grounds for quashing of the FIR or the subsequent proceedings in the light of the law laid down by the Apex Court in State of Haryana & Others versus Bhajan Lal & Others 1992 Supp (1) SCC 335.
